reading.body:
CoreSite Chicago Data Center (CH1) in Chicago, Illinois, is operated by CoreSite, but no IT capacity in megawatts has been published for this facility.

Without a published capacity figure, the facility cannot be sized against other data centers in this collection, or judged for whether it could plausibly host AI training infrastructure, which typically requires tens of megawatts and up. What is on record is the facility's location and operator, not its scale.

CoreSite Chicago Data Center (CH1) holds 6 published certifications: SOC 1 Type 2 (audited controls over financial reporting processes), SOC 2 Type 2 (audited controls over security, availability, and confidentiality, tested over time rather than at a point), PCI DSS (the standard required to handle payment card data), HIPAA (handling of protected health information), ISO 27001 (a certified information security management system), NIST 800-53 (alignment with the federal security control catalog). Together these qualify the facility for regulated workloads spanning security auditing, payments, and healthcare data, though which specific tenants rely on which certification is not disclosed.

Illinois has 13 facilities mapped in this site's dataset, of which 6 publish a megawatt figure, totaling 236 MW.
